details.groundedness_reasoning: The gold target claims that PVOIL’s price for RON 92-III was 19.630 VND per liter. Citation [5] lists 19.630 for RON 95-III, not RON 92, and identifies the seller as BCA–Thăng Long, not PVOIL. The cited E5 RON 92-II price there is 19.230. Citation [1] gives a national maximum price for E5RON92 of 19.238, not PVOIL’s RON 92-III retail price. No citation establishes the claimed product, retailer, and price together; a specific fact in the gold target is therefore unsupported.
